text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who came to cheer for me is so
happy
too... This is the best feeling ever!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who came to cheer for me is so
happy
too... This is the best feeling ever!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And it's not just the people at the
venue
but everyone in my hometown
too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I just spoke to my dad on the phone
earlier, and
he said he's going to raise a
toast with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I can't let my victory go to my
head!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It won't do to act like this in front of all
my fans.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I have to work even harder to put smiles
on
everyone's faces!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This is just the beginning! I still
have room
to grow and get stronger!
